fact_check.claim: Visa appointment can come no more than 120 days before the program starts (intro and dates list)
fact_check.note: brief §6 cites the Cornell international FAQ; marked there as not a housing rule, and the page does not call it one.

fact_check.claim: Lease may be signed from abroad, sight unseen
fact_check.note: brief: leases must often be signed sight unseen before arrival.

fact_check.claim: March to April (grad students) or the fall before (undergrads who want Collegetown): search and sign
fact_check.note: brief has grad timing March to April; Collegetown leases open about 10 to 16 months before move-in, so the fall before an August move-in fits.

fact_check.claim: About Aug 1: when most Ithaca leases start
fact_check.note: brief: most leases end July 31 and the next starts on or about Aug 1.

fact_check.claim: On arrival: move-in inspection and photos, and buy renters insurance
fact_check.note: Cornell checklist says purchase renter's insurance; the brief does not call it required, and the page does not either.

fact_check.claim: Winter break: ask housing@cornell.edu if you need a campus option over the break
fact_check.note: brief: students who cannot travel home may ask housing@cornell.edu about on-campus break housing.

fact_check.claim: Aug 31 of the following year: free first-year TCAT rides end for fall starters
fact_check.note: brief: fall entrants Aug 31 of the following year, spring entrants Dec 31; the page limits this to fall starters.

fact_check.claim: Guide descriptions for the 7 housing guides: international guide (no SSN, nothing up front beyond the one-month cap, sight unseen), listings, landlord vetting, lease, repairs, eviction, pillar
fact_check.note: Checked each against its title and meta. The international guide covers no SSN, the one-month deposit-plus-advance cap and paying from abroad. The listings guide has an international signing-from-abroad reader block. The landlord guide covers certificate and safety-tool checks. Titles and metas for the lease, repair, eviction and pillar guides match the descriptions.

fact_check.claim: Housing tools linked: lease fee/deposit checker and off-campus move-in checklist
fact_check.note: Both queue rows are published with slugs matching the links and list the international reader. I did not find the tool files by glob, so the link text rests on the queue rows.

fact_check.claim: Getting-around sections (guides, tools, dates: Oct 1 to Dec 1, Nov 26, Dec 23, Jan 6)
fact_check.note: Not this topic's sections; checked against their own brief, not judged here.
